name: ACP
summary: 通过 ACP（Agent Client Protocol）协议从手机新建并操作 Gemini CLI、Goose、GitHub Copilot CLI、Augment、Factory Droid 等 agent 的任务：看回复、回复、审批、中断
summaryEn: Start and drive tasks in Gemini CLI, Goose, GitHub Copilot CLI, Augment, Factory Droid and other agents over ACP (Agent Client Protocol) from your phone: read replies, reply, approve and interrupt

cli.note: 只接 Kiteline 新建的任务
只接 Kiteline 新建的任务（协议用 OpenCode 的 ACP 入口 + 假模型实测）
Windows 上还没实测，暂不在新任务面板里列出

limitsNote: 这些 agent 用你自己的账号或 API Key，额度和余额请在对应服务的控制台查看，「今日用量」中不显示
limitsNoteEn: These agents use your own accounts or API keys; check quota and balance in each service's console, as it isn't shown under Today's usage

gaps.text: 只接 Kiteline 新建的任务：ACP 只能由客户端拉起新的 agent 进程，接不了你在终端里已经开着的会话
gaps.textEn: Only tasks started from Kiteline: ACP can only launch a new agent process, so sessions you already opened in a terminal can't be attached

gaps.text: 电脑上的 Kiteline 重启后，这些任务会结束（agent 是 Kiteline 拉起的子进程）；记录保存在电脑上
gaps.textEn: These tasks end when Kiteline on your computer restarts (the agents run as its child processes); transcripts stay on the computer

gaps.text: Gemini CLI、Goose、Copilot CLI、Augment、Droid 各家没有逐个真机实测（要各自的账号），协议本身已用 OpenCode 的 ACP 入口实测
gaps.textEn: Gemini CLI, Goose, Copilot CLI, Augment and Droid haven't each been tested on real accounts yet; the protocol itself was tested with OpenCode's ACP mode

gaps.text: Windows 上还没实测，暂不开放
gaps.textEn: Not tested on Windows yet, so it's off there

speaker: Agent
notes: 新建任务时在 Agent 里选「Gemini CLI（ACP）」等条目，由 Kiteline 以 ACP 客户端身份在后台运行它。电脑上要先装好对应的命令行 agent 并登录。
notesEn: When starting a new task, choose an entry such as "Gemini CLI (ACP)" and Kiteline runs it in the background as an ACP client. Install and sign in to the agent's command-line tool on your computer first.
